structural_reasons: STRUCTURAL GAP: a participant-directed 404(c) menu assumes daily pricing and daily participant liquidity, whereas repurchases are suspended (cell 3.1). Direct DIA use requires a bridging structure: CIT sleeve, managed account, or TDF sleeve (cell 3.5).
Repurchase program suspended (cell 3.1): ordinary repurchase requests are not accepted, so participant liquidity depends on the program reopening. Capacity is 0%. Gating precedent on top (3.3).
Early repurchase economics: 5% if held < 1 year (2.7). Relevant to participant-level churn (2.7).
scenario_reasons: Capacity: repurchases are suspended (cell 3.1): ordinary requests are not accepted. Capacity is 0% until the program reopens.

Filed outflow proxy (Schedule H, plan year 2024-05-01 to 2025-04-30): 10.8% of the position per year vs 0% annual wrapper capacity, the plan's total expenses less administrative expenses over beginning net assets, applied to the position. EXCEEDS: repurchases are closed, so every request waits for the program to reopen.

Slider assumption (illustrative): 9.2% of the position per year vs 0% annual wrapper capacity, from tail turnover 20%/yr on the 28.2% of accounts that are separated and active turnover 5%/yr on the rest. Shown beside the filed rate, not blended with it. EXCEEDS: repurchases are closed, so every request waits for the program to reopen.

Scenario verdict (ILLUSTRATIVE, this plan): misaligned. Base rung: the filed outflow proxy 10.8% of the position per year exceeds the annual wrapper capacity 0% (repurchases suspended (3.1), prorated under stress before (3.3)). Proration assumption: an oversubscribed offer is filled pro rata and the unfilled remainder waits for the next window.

filed_outflow.label: filed outflow proxy
filed_outflow.formula: (total expenses minus total administrative expenses) / net assets at the beginning of the plan year * 100
filed_outflow.source: Schedule H totals of the plan's Form 5500 for plan year 2024-05-01 to 2025-04-30, from the plan record
filed_outflow.what: total expenses less administrative expenses over beginning net assets, an upper bound on benefit payments while Schedule H line 2e is not in the record

stressed_scenario.assumptions: the filed outflow proxy plus the increment the stress multiples add under stress (tail turnover x2, active turnover x1.5 over the slider assumption)
stressed_scenario.outcome: EXCEEDS annual wrapper capacity (18.2% vs 0%). Unmet demand rolls into later windows (gating-equivalent outcome)
